_note: Inputs of the Tier 2B study. The two NESO files are byte-identical copies of files already in this repository (built by mocry-codex from the NESO data portal); clean_daily.csv is this member's own cleaned daily table from the independent Tier 1 study.

clean_daily.csv.content: Cleaned daily table built by t1_data.py from the five supplied CSVs; prices in 2023 pounds.

neso_demand.csv.content: Row dated t: mean, minimum and maximum of the cardinal-point demand forecasts for day t+1 in the latest issue published before the end of day t (UTC).

neso_wind.csv.content: Row dated t: mean forecast wind output and capacity for day t+1 issued before the end of day t (UTC). 175 of the 1,825 days in 2021-2025 carry the previous forecast forward and are flagged.

t1_model.py (study folder).content: Unchanged copy of the Tier 1 model, used for parameters, daily energy accounting and the Tier 1 reference results.
